H10: preview routing neither retired the source nor added verification; its sample excluded all four gaps. H11–H12: planned work remains unexecuted, with no further recorded source changes. Missing audits do not establish corruption.

NEXT
Complete K95–K96 revision-1 comparisons, then synchronize and verify both deltas. If those two comparisons match, M0 becomes fully verified: 96 snapshot matches, but only 95 current matches out of 97; retirement still fails. Retirement requires verified destination matches for every current key/revision, accounting for subsequent writes.
